Container.Name: soundbending-secuencias
Container.Overview: Private multitrack library. Upload WAV stems per song, add sections, preview the mix in a browser, and download sessions to the Soundbending Secuencias Mac player.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the website and the app API

Config.Name: Library data
Config.Description: Database and all uploaded audio. Point this at a share with plenty of space.

Config.Name: Admin username
Config.Description: First account, created on first start only

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Password for the first account (first start only). Leave blank to have one generated and printed in the container log.

Config.Name: Auto sections from guide
Config.Description: 1 = listen to guide tracks after upload and add section markers. 0 = off.
